Name: Beach Anime Portraits (All Townsfolk - Variants Added)
Author: Absynnian
Description:
Anime versions of the beach portraits, built from the existing anime portrait mods. [CP] and XNB version now available. Currently covers all the villagers who were given beach portraits by ConcernedApe, also did some of the alt versions per request. If there's a specific character version you want me to look at porting, leave a comment with a link to that version and I'll take a look when I get a chance.

**Added a beach portrait set for Olivia AND Sophia out of SVE, OhoDavi hasn't done an official version of it**
** Also added the Makeup portrait set for Sophia, since OhoDavi hasn't done an official version of it**

Credit to LastLoveToYou and SAP team for (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5494?tab=description) I used their existing swimwear portraits as the basis for most of the portraits. 
Credit to Bunnihime for (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48?tab=files), I used their version of Haley as the basis for my edits of that character.
Credit to OhoDavi especially for ( https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839?tab=description), their work is the ultimate basis from which my edits stem. I will almost certainly remove this if/when they update to cover the new content themselves as their work is simply terrific.
